title: [loganalyzer] Broadcom syncd PORT_PHY_ATTR collectData ERR syslog causes teardown failures on 7260CX3
author: ZhaohuiS
body:
## Description

After sonic-swss [#4407](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/4407) (cherry-pick of [#4223](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/4223)) landed on 202511 on Apr 6, Broadcom platforms generate ERR-level syslog entries every ~10 seconds from syncd:

`
syncd#syncd: SAI_API_PORT:brcm_sai_get_port_attribute_cmn:10440 RX signal detect status get N attrib 149 failed with error Feature unavailable (0xfffffff0)
syncd#syncd: :- collectData: Failed to get port attr for VID 0x10000000000XX, RID:0x1000000XX: -2
`

This causes **all tests using loganalyzer** to fail at teardown on Arista-7260CX3 and other Broadcom platforms. On 202511 image 20251110.20 this produced **8,700+ test failures**.

## Root Cause - Two-PR Activation Pattern

| Component | Master PR | 202511 Cherry-pick | Role |
|-----------|-----------|-------------------|------|
| sonic-sairedis | [#1674](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/1674) (Jan 30) | [#1785](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/1785) (Mar 9) | Adds PORT_PHY_ATTR polling in syncd FlexCounter |
| sonic-swss | [#4223](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/4223) (Mar 26) | [#4407](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/4407) (Apr 6) | **ACTIVATOR** - writes PORT_PHY_ATTR entries to FLEX_COUNTER_DB |

sonic-sairedis [#1799](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/1799) / [#1815](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/1815) partially fixed PORT_PHY_SERDES_ATTR but **missed** PORT_PHY_ATTR (FlexCounter.cpp line 1987 - initAttrData return value not checked).

## Affected Platforms

- Arista-7260CX3-C64 (confirmed)
- Arista-7060X6-64PE (confirmed)
- Likely all Broadcom ASIC platforms where SAI_PORT_ATTR_RX_SIGNAL_DETECT is not supported

## Fix PRs

- **syncd fix (proper):** [sonic-sairedis #1855](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/pull/1855) - Check initAttrData return value in PORT_PHY_ATTR::collectData
- **loganalyzer workaround:** [sonic-mgmt #24017](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/24017) - Add collectData failure pattern to loganalyzer ignore list

## Failure Timeline

| Date | Image | Platform | Failures | Trigger |
|------|-------|----------|----------|---------|
| Mar 21-27 | 20251110.17 | 7060X6 | 14-56/day | #1785 only |
| Mar 28 | internal.158470515 | 7260CX3 | 1,240 | #4223 synced from master |
| Apr 14-16 | 20251110.20 | All Broadcom | 8,707 | #4407 + SAI upgrade #26625 |

linkedPullRequests.title: [loganalyzer] Ignore rsyslog-collapsed "collectData: Failed to get port attr" logs
linkedPullRequests.author: deerao02
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #24023

The LogAnalyzer ignore rule for the benign syncd `collectData: Failed to get port attr for VID ... RID ...: -<code>` error anchored on the literal substring `#syncd: :- collectData`. rsyslog deduplicates repeated identical lines into a summary of the form:

```
ERR syncd#syncd: message repeated N times: [ :- collectData: Failed to get port attr for VID 0x..., RID:0x...: -8]
```

Because `message repeated N times: [ ` sits between `#syncd:` and `:- collectData`, the rigid anchor does not match the collapsed line. LogAnalyzer then flags it and QoS SAI cases error on teardown (observed on Broadcom 7060x6 ft2/lt2 nightlies, e.g. `str4-7060x6-512-4`, image `20251110.38` — 14 QoS SAI teardown errors in a single nightly).

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement


### Back port request
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511
- [x] 202512
- [ ] 202605

Tracking issue/work item for backport/cherry-pick request: #24023
Failure type: day-one issue (test infrastructure — the collapsed-log form was never covered by the ignore rule)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Eliminate false-positive LogAnalyzer teardown failures on Broadcom 7060x6 nightlies. A previous fix generalized the error code (`-2` -> `-\d+`), but the rule still only matched the un-collapsed line, so rsyslog's `message repeated N times: [ ... ]` summary continued to trip LogAnalyzer and error the QoS SAI cases at teardown.

#### How did you do it?
Replaced the rigid `#syncd: :- collectData` anchor with `#syncd:.*collectData` in `loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt`, so both the direct and the rsyslog-collapsed forms are ignored. The rest of the pattern (VID/RID hex and `-\d+` error code) is unchanged, keeping the rule scoped to this specific benign error.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Validated the new regex against the exact lines from the failing nightly: it matches both the direct line and the `message repeated N times: [ ... ]` collapsed line, matches multi-asic `syncd0`, and does not match unrelated `collectData` errors.

#### Any platform specific information?
Broadcom 7060x6 (ft2/lt2 topologies). The SAI return code observed on this platform is `-8`; the log volume triggers rsyslog message collapsing.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
N/A — not a new test case.

### Documentation
N/A — no documentation change required.
